title: draw-result/1: the verdict of a replay request (mzdraw::outcome)
description: Checked by crates/mzdraw/tests/outcome.rs without a JSON Schema validator (none is a dependency): the key order (x-key-order, on the raw text, also inside failed, created, removed and each expect item), the required keys, the types and the stage values are asserted by hand; the other constraints here are documentation. The request `diff` (plan-15) is not answered by this document: it stands alone and any of `report`, `dry_run`, `expect`, `id` with it is the keyed error `error.draw2.diffAlone`.

id.description: the request's own id, else its 0-based index in the batch

ok.description: every op ran and every expectation holds

dry_run.description: only when the request asked for a dry run

patch.description: RESERVED, never written yet (plan-27: the canonical patch of a goal)

out.description: what Editor::save(out) wrote; only when ok and not a dry run

created.description: ids after minus before, ascending, empty lists left out

removed.description: ids before minus after, ascending, empty lists left out

imported.description: what the import of the start text (import) and the file (import_base64) did not keep or changed: the notes the page shows under its import (io::Imported::notes), in that order, less the computed layout (draw2.import.placeholder, no loss) and less a note whose number is 0 (outcome::import_notes); the key is left out when there is nothing to say. One item per key, n the sum over the text and the file (draw2.import.stereoGroups for the enhanced-stereo groups the drawing does not keep, queryAtoms, queryBonds, sgroups, skipped records, ...), except draw2.import.smilesLine: one item per SMILES line that could not be read, n its 1-based line number, at most 10, the others counted by draw2.import.smilesMore. The key was added to draw-result/1 without a new format id: a consumer must accept keys it does not know (additive keys)

key.description: the i18n key of the note, draw2.import.*

n.description: how many (the sum over the text and the file); for draw2.import.smilesLine the 1-based number of the line

lost.description: what the output format cannot hold: one item per kind, only when something is lost (atom maps in CDXML and CML); the file is still written

key.description: the i18n key, draw2.export.mapsLost for atom maps

changed.description: present when a command of the request reports whether it changed the drawing (today scheme:orient, pathway:anchor and pathway:route): whether the commands changed it (false: a no-op, nothing was changed)

dirty.description: whether the final drawing differs from the saved point: a start text or file (import) and the command save set the point, any edit clears it, undo back to it makes the drawing clean again; the commands new and open refuse a dirty drawing unless their args say discard true (error.draw2.unsaved)

orient.description: only when a command was scheme:orient: one item per product structure of its last run, in the order the plan took them

arrow.description: the arrow the product stands after

from.description: an atom of the reactant it was oriented on (0: none had a core)

to.description: an atom of the product (0 with from 0: an arrow that was not read, over the cap of 200 arrows)

status.description: oriented: turned; already: nothing to do; no_core: no shared core of 3 atoms; too_large: over 500 heavy atoms or the search limit; overlap: not applied (the whole command is refused)

flip.description: the product was mirrored (never with a wedge)

before.description: root-mean-square distance of the core atoms before, bond lengths, the shift taken away

at.description: only for overlap: the atom or object it would run into

grid.description: only when a command was grid: what its last run left where it was

left.description: the ids of the free objects (a text, an arrow, a plus sign or a curve anchored at no atom) that stood within 3 bond lengths of a structure of the grid, where it stood or where the grid puts it, in the order of the drawing: the grid does not move them

stage.description: `log`, `command` and `proposal` (a refused `propose`, or a refused entry of `accept`) are written today; select, plan and grant are RESERVED, never written yet

op.description: 0-based index in log (stage log) or in commands (stage command)

key.description: the i18n key of the refusal

id.description: the id it is about, 0 when none

candidates.description: RESERVED, never written yet (stage select: the atom ids of each match)

rows.description: RESERVED, never written yet (stage command on a command that reads rows: every failing row, in line order)
